_meta.description: Template for demo-ids.local.json — the per-deployment ID file this pattern produces. The live file is HYBRID: Azure resource fields (flat top-level keys) are auto-written by infra/deploy.ps1 from the Bicep deploymentSummary and overwritten on every successful deploy; nested objects (fabric, sp-rag-di-caller, copilotStudio) are populated manually during the Fabric and Copilot Studio setup phases and preserved across deploys (deploy.ps1 merges rather than overwrites). The live file is gitignored — never commit a populated copy.
consumedBy: scripts/post_deploy_search.py (reads top-level Azure fields: foundryOpenAIEndpoint, embeddingDeployment, embeddingModel, searchService, searchEndpoint, searchIndexName, searchDataSourceName, searchIndexerName, storageAccount, chunksContainer, resourceGroup, subscriptionId)
Fabric pipeline pl_ingest_docs (operator copies fabric.* and sp-rag-di-caller.* into pipeline parameters at build time — see docs/03b-fabric-setup.md § F8.0)

searchPrincipalId: <auto-populated — AI Search system-assigned MI object ID>

fabric._note: Populated manually during docs/03b-fabric-setup.md. The Fabric REST API has no Bicep/ARM surface for workspaces, lakehouses, or pipelines, so these IDs are recorded here as a reference for human re-use and for binding into pipeline parameters.
fabric.capacitySku: <F-SKU — F2 minimum for demo, F16+ recommended for prod>

sp-rag-di-caller._note: Populated manually after running `az ad sp create-for-rbac --name sp-rag-di-caller` (see docs/03b-fabric-setup.md § F2.2). The SP is used by the Fabric OCR notebook to acquire a bearer token for Document Intelligence (served by the Foundry resource). NOTE: The `password` field below is the SP's client secret — it is ALSO stored in Key Vault as `di-sp-secret` (which is the canonical home; the Fabric notebook reads it from there at runtime). The copy here is kept temporarily for diagnostic convenience and SHOULD BE REMOVED once Key Vault retrieval is validated end-to-end.
sp-rag-di-caller.password: <sp-client-secret — also stored in Key Vault as `di-sp-secret`>

copilotStudio._note: Populated manually during docs/03c-copilot-studio-setup.md. Copilot Studio is Power Platform (not Azure) and has no Bicep / Terraform surface.
